items.title: cryptship 第三部分：诚实的威胁模型与加固成本
items.title_orig: cryptship | Part 3 — An Honest Threat Model, and the Hardening That Raises the Cost
items.summary: 文章说明磁盘镜像为密文，但应用运行时明文在容器内存中，宿主机 root 仍可读取，用户态手段无法改变。
items.summary_orig: Every "protect your code" product has to answer one question honestly: what about root? This part is cryptship's answer. 🧱 Where the line is The image on disk is ciphertext. But once your app runs, its plaintext is in the container's memory, and root on the host can read that memory . No user-space trick changes that.

items.title: cryptship 第二部分：同一加载器支持三种密钥来源
items.title_orig: cryptship | Part 2 — Air-Gapped, On-Prem, Cloud: One Loader, Three Key Providers
items.summary: cryptship 用同一加载器和许可证格式支持隔离网络、本地数据中心与云环境，区别仅在内容密钥获取方式。
items.summary_orig: Customers run software in very different places: a disconnected network, their own data centre, or a cloud account. cryptship handles all three with one loader and one license format . The only thing that changes is how the content key is obtained.

items.title: cryptship 第一部分：不留下可篡改的许可证校验分支
items.title_orig: cryptship | Part 1 — No 'Is the License Valid?' Boolean to Patch
items.summary: 多数许可证校验是布尔分支，找到即可绕过；cryptship 让内容密钥来自许可证，镜像中不存密钥，因此没有该分支可改。
items.summary_orig: Most license checks look like this somewhere in the binary: if ! license . Valid ( ) { os . Exit ( 1 ) } Find that branch, flip one instruction, and the check is gone. cryptship is designed so that there is no such branch to flip . 🔑 The key comes from the license The content key that decrypts your app is never stored in the image.

items.title: AI 向量嵌入打破 Parquet 与 Arrow 的列式假设
items.title_orig: AI Embeddings Break Columnar Assumptions in Parquet and Arrow
items.summary: 嵌入列宽大、高熵、从不按值过滤且总是整列读取，应作为独立物理层并延迟物化。
items.summary_orig: TL;DR — Columnar engines like DuckDB and Arrow assume you scan a few columns and filter on values. An embedding column violates every one of those assumptions: it is wide, high-entropy, never filtered by value, and always read whole. Treat it as a separate physical tier, use fixed-size layouts, and late-materialize vectors after metadata filters.

items.title: CI 中 pip 访问 PyPI 超时与 429 的解决办法
items.title_orig: pip ReadTimeoutError and 429 from PyPI in CI
items.summary: 默认 15 秒超时太短，冷任务会重下全部依赖，应调高超时并缓存 wheel。
items.summary_orig: A pip ReadTimeoutError against PyPI in CI means the connection opened and then went quiet: the host accepted the request and sent nothing back inside the socket timeout. On GitHub Actions the fix is to raise the timeout the failing pip actually reads and to cache the wheels, because the default is 15 seconds and a cold job downloads everything again.

items.summary: 我们通常认为月球是一个静态的、漂浮的物体，在其整个生命周期中基本上保持不变，偶尔的小行星撞击是个例外。这种理解是基于物理学的——当一颗巨大的原行星形成时，月球应该在形成后迅速冷却。
items.summary_orig: We typically think of the Moon as a static, floating object that has remained the same for basically its entire lifetime, with an occasional asteroid impact serving as an exception. That understanding is grounded in physics - the Moon should have cooled rapidly after forming when a huge protoplanet hit the early Earth around 4.5 billion years ago.
